name: Veronica Elias
office: Pasadena Unified School District, Board of Education, District No. 3

items.text: Veronica Elias is an educator. According to her campaign, she has more than 25 years of experience as a teacher, assistant principal, and principal. Her campaign says she holds a doctorate in educational leadership from USC and led a school to a 2026 California Distinguished School recognition. She has called for an independent administrative audit before any school closures. She wants increased support for students with disabilities and multilingual learners. She supports measurable plans to address declining enrollment and chronic absenteeism. Elias emphasized stronger board oversight and community engagement.
